data.name: Set_EmbIntro
data.value: Provider that generates the chunk vectors at ingestion and the query vectors at search. Applies without restart on this instance — in multi-replica, re-apply on each one (per-instance config). 'dimensions' is only accepted when equal to the vector store schema — and changing the model requires reindexing the sources: already-written vectors keep the old dimensions/model.

data.name: Set_ResIntro
data.value: Fallback policy for chat providers and MCP tools ('Resilience:Fallback'). On transient failures (429/5xx/timeout), a call can be served by an equivalent candidate of the same capability — it never crosses the caller's permission or scope. 'observe' classifies and logs without switching; 'enforce' performs the switch within budget.

data.name: Set_VectorExplain
data.value: Stores the embeddings — numeric vectors that represent the meaning of each indexed chunk. At search, the question is vectorized and compared by (cosine) similarity: it finds related content even without exact keywords. It powers the RAG; the HNSW index makes that search fast on large bases.
